component.name: colza
component.summary: Pick colors on screen and check WCAG contrast

description.p: colza picks colors anywhere on screen with a pixel-level magnifier, compares two colors and checks them against the WCAG contrast requirements.

ul.li: Magnifier showing the pixels around the cursor
Pixel-precise cursor movement with the arrow keys
WCAG AA and AAA results for text and non-text contrast
Follows the desktop's light/dark preference and text size
